name: Centro Zen L'Arco – Zenmon Ji
reason: Too thin on video: the centre's YouTube channel (@centrozenlarco, 295 subscribers, 15 videos, latest June 2025) has embedding disabled on 14 of 15 videos (oEmbed 401); the only embeddable one is a 5-minute film clip. Otherwise sound: Soto Zen centre in Rome (Piazza Dante 15) affiliated to San Francisco Zen Center, abbot Dario Doshin Girolami, email info@romazen.it. Could be revisited as a teacher listing if the owner accepts a listing without videos.
